verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine, and model management is a fair axis for local LLM runtimes. However, the evidence only covers serving features: HF model integration, quantization, the OpenAI-compatible server and CLI serve/benchmark commands. Nothing documents a unified place to manage downloaded models, saved prompts, or per-model configurations.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
